verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ጸውዖ፡ ለጦብያ፡ ጦቢት፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ርኢ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልድየ፡ አስቦ፡ ለዝኩ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘሖረ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወዓዲ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ትወስክ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: Then Tobit called his son Tobias, and said unto him, My son, see that the man have his wages, which went with thee, and thou must give him more.

translations.lxx: Then Tobit called his son Tobias, and said unto him, My son, see that the man have his wages, which went with thee, and thou must give him more.
translations.ron: Şi chemând Tobit pe fiul său, Tobie, i-a zis: "Fiule, pregăteşte plata omului care a fost cu tine! Trebuie să-i mai adăugăm ceva".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε Τωβὶτ Τωβίαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· ὅρα, τέκνον, μισθὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ συνελθόντι σοι· καὶ προσθεῖναι αὐτῷ δεῖ.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ጦቢያ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ አባ፡ ዘይነክየኒ፡ አልቦ፡ ለእመ፡ ወሀብክዎ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ነዋይ፡ ዘአምጻእኩ።
verses.translation: And Tobias said unto him, O father, it is no harm to me to give him half of those things which I have brought:

translations.lxx: And Tobias said unto him, O father, it is no harm to me to give him half of those things which I have brought:
translations.ron: Şi el a răspuns: "Tată, socot că n-am să fiu în pagubă de îi voi da jumătate din cele ce am adus;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, πάτερ, οὐ βλάπτομαι δοὺς αὐτῷ τὸ ἥμισυ ὧν ἐνήνοχα,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አዕተወኒ፡ ኀቤከ፡ በዳኅና፡ ወለብእሲትየኒ፡ ፈወሳ፡ ወብሩረኒ፡ አምጽአ፡ ከማሁ፡ ለከሂ፡ ፈወሰከ።
verses.translation: for he hath brought me again to thee in safety, and made whole my wife, and brought me the money, and likewise healed thee.

translations.lxx: for he hath brought me again to thee in safety, and made whole my wife, and brought me the money, and likewise healed thee.
translations.ron: Pentru că el m-a adus la tine sănătos şi pe femeia mea a lecuit-o; mi-a adus argintul şi te-a vindecat şi pe tine!"
translations.grk: ὅτι με ἀγήοχέ σοι ὑγιῆ, καὶ τὴν γυναῖκά μου ἐθεράπευσε, καὶ τὸ ἀργύριόν μου ἤνεγκε, καὶ σὲ ὁμοίως ἐθεράπευσε.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ አቡሁ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ነበብከ።
verses.translation: Then the old man said, It is due unto him.

translations.lxx: Then the old man said, It is due unto him.
translations.ron: Şi a zis bătrânul: "I se cuvine!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ πρεσβύτης, δικαιοῦται αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መልአክ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ንሣእ፡ መንፈቀ፡ ኵሉ፡ ንዋይ፡ ዘአምጻእክሙ፡ ምስሌክሙ፡ ወሑር፡ በዳኅን።
verses.translation: So he called the angel, and he said unto him, Take half of all that ye have brought, and go away in safety.

translations.lxx: So he called the angel, and he said unto him, Take half of all that ye have brought, and go away in safety.
translations.ron: Şi a chemat pe înger şi i-a zis: "Ia jumătate din toate cele ce aţi adus, şi mergi în pace!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸν ἄγγελον, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, λάβε τὸ ἥμισυ πάντων ὧν ἐνηνόχατε, καὶ ὕπαγε ὑγιαίνων.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖሙ፡ ሩፋኤል፡ ውእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ለክልኤሆሙ፡ ወአግኃሦሙ፡ ወይቤሎሙ፡ ባርክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወግነዩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወወሀቡ፡ ዕበየ፡ ለስሙ፡ ወእመኑ፡ ቦቱ፡ በቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘሕያው፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ሠናያተ፡ ወአዕኵትዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወሰብሑ፡ ለስሙ፡ ወንግሩ፡ ግብሮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በክብር፡ አርእዩ፡ ወኢትትሐከዩ፡ ገንየ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: Then he took them both apart, and said unto them, Bless God, praise him, and magnify him, and praise him for the things which he hath done unto you in the sight of all that live. It is good to praise God, and exalt his name, and honourably to shew forth the works of God; therefore be not slack to praise him.

translations.lxx: Then he took them both apart, and said unto them, Bless God, praise him, and magnify him, and praise him for the things which he hath done unto you in the sight of all that live. It is good to praise God, and exalt his name, and honourably to shew forth the works of God; therefore be not slack to praise him.
translations.ron: Atunci îngerul i-a chemat pe amândoi deoparte şi le-a zis: "Binecuvântaţi pe Dumnezeu, slăviţi-L şi cunoaşteţi slava Lui şi mărturisiţi înaintea tuturor celor vii ce a făcut El pentru voi! Bun lucru este a binecuvânta pe Dumnezeu, a preaînălţa numele Lui şi a vesti, slăvind faptele lui Dumnezeu! Şi voi să nu vă leneviţi a-L preaslăvi.
translations.grk: Τότε καλέσας τοὺς δύο κρυπτῶς, εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, εὐλογεῖτε τὸν Θεὸν, καὶ αὐτῷ ἐξομολογεῖσθε, καὶ μεγαλωσύνην δίδοτε αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε αὐτῷ ἐνώπιον πάντων τῶν ζώντων περὶ ὧν ἐποίησε μεθʼ ὑμῶν· ἀγαθὸν τὸ εὐλογεῖν τὸν Θεὸν, καὶ ὑψοῦν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, τοὺς λόγους τῶν ἔργων τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐντίμως ὑποδεικνύοντες· καὶ μὴ ὀκνεῖτε ἐξομολογεῖσθαι αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ምሥጢረ፡ መንግሥት፡ ሠናይ፡ ለኀቢእ፡ ወለግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔርሰ፡ ይከሥትዎ፡ በግብር፡ ግበርዋ፡ ለሠናይት፡ ወኢትረክበክሙ፡ እኪት።
verses.translation: It is good to keep close the secret of a king, but it is honourable to reveal the works of God. Do that which is good, and no evil shall touch you.

translations.lxx: It is good to keep close the secret of a king, but it is honourable to reveal the works of God. Do that which is good, and no evil shall touch you.
translations.ron: Taina regelui se cuvine s-o păstrezi, iar lucrurile lui Dumnezeu este de laudă să le vesteşti. Faceţi bine şi răul nu vă va ajunge!
translations.grk: Μυστήριον βασιλέως καλὸν κρύψαι, τὰ δὲ ἔργα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀνακαλύπτειν ἐνδόξως· ἀγαθὸν ποιήσατε, καὶ κακὸν οὐχ εὑρήσει ὑμᾶς.

verses.geez: ሠናይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ጸሎት፡ ምስለ፡ ሰላም፡ ወምጽዋት፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ይኄይስ፡ ኅዳጥ፡ ዘበጽድቅ፡ እምብዙኅ፡ ብዕለ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወይኄይስ፡ ውኂበ፡ ምጽዋት፡ እምዘጊቦቱ፡ ለወርቅ።
verses.translation: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:

translations.lxx: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:
translations.ron: Mai mult preţuieşte rugăciunea cu post şi cu milostenie şi cu dreptate, decât bogăţie cu nedreptate; mai bine să faci milostenie, decât să aduni aur,
translations.grk: Ἀγαθὸν προσευχὴ μετὰ νηστείας καὶ ἐλεημοσύνης καὶ δικαιοσύνης· ἀγαθὸν τὸ ὀλίγον μετὰ δικαιοσύνης, ἢ πολὺ μετὰ ἀδικίας· καλὸν ποιῆσαι ἐλεημοσύνην ἢ θησαυρίσαι χρυσίον.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ምጽዋት፡ ታድኅን፡ እሞት፡ ወታነጽሕ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ወእለሰ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወምጽዋተ፡ ይመልዑ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ሕይወተ።
verses.translation: for alms doth deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:

translations.lxx: for alms doth deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:
translations.ron: Căci milostenia izbăveşte de la moarte şi curăţă orice păcat. Cei ce fac milostenie şi dreptate vor trăi mult.
translations.grk: Ἐλεημοσύνη γὰρ ἐκ θανάτου ῥύεται, καὶ αὕτη ἀποκαθαριεῖ πᾶσαν ἁμαρτίαν· οἱ ποιοῦντες ἐλεημοσύνας καὶ δικαιοσύνας πλησθήσονται ζωῆς.

verses.geez: ወእለሂ፡ ይኤብሱ፡ ይጸልእዋ፡ ለነፍሶሙ።
verses.translation: but they that sin are enemies to their own life.

translations.lxx: but they that sin are enemies to their own life.
translations.ron: Iar păcătoşii sunt duşmanii vieţii lor.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ ἁμαρτάνοντες πολέμιοί εἰσι τῆς ἑαυτῶν ζωῆς.

verses.geez: ወናሁ፡ ኢየኀብእ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ ወእቤለክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ምሥጢረ፡ መንግሥት፡ ሠናይ፡ ለኃቢዕ፡ ወግብሮሰ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይከሥትዎ፡ በክብር።
verses.translation: Surely I will keep close nothing from you. For I said, It was good to keep close the secret of a king, but that it was honourable to reveal the works of God.

translations.lxx: Surely I will keep close nothing from you. For I said, It was good to keep close the secret of a king, but that it was honourable to reveal the works of God.
translations.ron: Nimic n-am să ascund de voi şi v-am şi spus: "Taina regelui se cuvine s-o păstrezi, iar lucrurile lui Dumnezeu este de laudă să le vesteşti".
translations.grk: Οὐ μὴ κρύψω ἀφʼ ὑμῶν πᾶν ῥῆμα· εἴρηκα δὴ, μυστήριον βασιλέως κρύψαι καλὸν, τὰ δὲ ἔργα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀνακαλύπτειν ἐνδόξως.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ አመ፡ ጸለይክሙ፡ አንተ፡ ወሣራ፡ መርዓትከ፡ አነ፡ አባዕኩ፡ ተዝካረ፡ ስእለትክሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለቅዱሰ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ወአንተኒ፡ አመ፡ ትቀብር፡ አብድንተ፡ አሜሃ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ምስሌከ።
verses.translation: Now therefore, when thou didst pray, and Sara thy daughter in law, I did bring the remembrance of your prayers before the Holy One: and when thou didst bury the dead, I was with thee likewise.

translations.lxx: Now therefore, when thou didst pray, and Sara thy daughter in law, I did bring the remembrance of your prayers before the Holy One: and when thou didst bury the dead, I was with thee likewise.
translations.ron: Când te rugai tu şi nora ta Sara, eu duceam pomenirea rugăciunii voastre înaintea Celui Sfânt şi când îngropai tu pe cei morţi, încă eram cu tine.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν ὅτε προσηύξω σὺ καὶ ἡ νύμφη σου Σάῤῥα, ἐγὼ προσήγαγον τὸ μνημόσυνον τῆς προσευχῆς ὑμῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἁγίου· καὶ ὅτε ἔθαπτες τοὺς νεκροὺς, ὡσαύτως συμπαρήγμην σοι.

verses.geez: ወአመኒ፡ ኢተሐየይከ፡ ወተንሣእከ፡ ኀዲገከ፡ ምስሐከ፡ ወሖርከ፡ ትቀብር፡ በድነ፡ ወኢረሣእከ፡ ገቢረ፡ ሠናይ፡ አሜሃ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ምስሌከ።
verses.translation: And when thou didst not delay to rise up, and leave thy dinner, to go and cover the dead, thy good deed was not hid from me: but I was with thee.

translations.lxx: And when thou didst not delay to rise up, and leave thy dinner, to go and cover the dead, thy good deed was not hid from me: but I was with thee.
translations.ron: şi când tu nu te-ai lenevit să te scoli şi să-ţi laşi prânzul tău ca să te duci să ridici pe cel mort, binefacerea ta nu s-a ascuns de mine, ci eu eram cu tine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅτε οὐκ ὤκνησας ἀναστῆναι καὶ καταλιπεῖν τὸ ἄριστόν σου, ὅπως ἀπελθὼν περιστείλῃς τὸν νεκρὸν, οὐκ ἔλαθές με ἀγαθοποιῶν, ἀλλὰ σὺν σοὶ ἤμην.

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ፈነወኒ፡ ከመ፡ እፈውስከ፡ ወለሣራ፡ መርዓትከ፡ ከመ፡ እናዝዝ፡ ኃዘና።
verses.translation: And now God hath sent me to heal thee and Sara thy daughter in law.

translations.lxx: And now God hath sent me to heal thee and Sara thy daughter in law.
translations.ron: Şi acum Dumnezeu m-a trimis, să te vindec pe tine şi pe nora ta, Sara.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν ἀπέστειλέ με ὁ Θεὸς ἰάσασθαί σε καὶ τὴν νύμφην σου Σάῤῥαν.

verses.geez: አነ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሩፋኤል፡ መልአክ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብአቱ፡ ሊቃነ፡ መላእክት፡ ቅዱሳን፡ እለ፡ የዓርጉ፡ ጸሎቶሙ፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ ወያበውዑ፡ ቅድመ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ለዓቢይ፡ ወቅዱስ።
verses.translation: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.

translations.lxx: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.
translations.ron: Eu sunt Rafael, unul din cei şapte sfinţi îngeri, care ridică rugăciunile sfinţilor şi le înalţă înaintea slavei Celui Sfânt".
translations.grk: Ἐγώ εἰμι Ῥαφαήλ, εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἁγίων ἀγγέλων οἳ προσαναφέρουσι τὰς προσευχὰς τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ εἰσπορεύονται ἐνώπιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ ἁγίου.

verses.geez: ወሰሚዖሙ፡ ዘንተ፡ ደንገፁ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ወወድቁ፡ በገጾሙ፡ እስመ፡ ፈርሁ።
verses.translation: Then they were both troubled, and fell upon their faces: for they feared.

translations.lxx: Then they were both troubled, and fell upon their faces: for they feared.
translations.ron: Atunci s-au înspăimântat amândoi şi au căzut cu faţa la pământ, căci erau cuprinşi de frică.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐταράχθησαν οἱ δύο, καὶ ἔπεσον ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, ὅτι ἐφοβήθησαν.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ፡ ኢትፍርሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክክሙ፡ ባርክዎ።
verses.translation: But he said unto them, Fear not, for it shall go well with you; praise God therefore.

translations.lxx: But he said unto them, Fear not, for it shall go well with you; praise God therefore.
translations.ron: Dar el le-a zis: "Nu vă temeţi! Pace veţi avea! Binecuvântaţi pe Dumnezeu în veac!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, μὴ φοβεῖσθε, εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἔσται· τὸν δὲ Θεὸν εὐλογεῖτε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አኮ፡ ሊተ፡ አኰቴት፡ አላ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ ለአምላክክሙ፡ አምጽአኒ፡ ወበእንተዝ፡ ባርክዎ፡ ለአምላከ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: For not of any favour of mine, but by the will of our God I came; wherefore praise him for ever.

translations.lxx: For not of any favour of mine, but by the will of our God I came; wherefore praise him for ever.
translations.ron: Căci eu n-am venit de voia mea, ci după voia Dumnezeului nostru, de aceea să-L şi binecuvântaţi în veac.
translations.grk: ὅτι οὐ τῇ ἐμαυτοῦ χάριτι, ἀλλὰ τῇ θελήσει τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἦλθον, ὅθεν εὐλογεῖτε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.geez: ወበኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ወአነ፡ አስተርአይኩክሙ፡ ወርኢክሙ፡ ራእይየ፡ ኢበላዕኩ፡ ወኢሰተይኩ፡ ምስሌክሙ።
verses.translation: All these days I did appear unto you; but I did neither eat nor drink, but ye did see a vision.

translations.lxx: All these days I did appear unto you; but I did neither eat nor drink, but ye did see a vision.
translations.ron: În toate zilele am fost văzut de voi, dar eu n-am mâncat nici n-am băut, ci numai ochilor voştri s-a părut aceasta.
translations.grk: Πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ὠπτανόμην ὑμῖν, καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγον οὐδὲ ἔπιον, ἀλλὰ ὅρασιν ὑμεῖς ἐθεωρεῖτε.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ እመኑ፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመአ፡ ዓርግ፡ ኀበ፡ ዘፈነወኒ፡ ወመጻእኩ፡ እጽሐፍ፡ እሎንተ፡ መጻሕፍተ።
verses.translation: Now therefore give God thanks: for I go up to him that sent me; but write all things which are done in a book.

translations.lxx: Now therefore give God thanks: for I go up to him that sent me; but write all things which are done in a book.
translations.ron: Aşadar, preaslăviţi acum pe Dumnezeu, căci eu mă înalţ la Cel Care m-a trimis, şi scrieţi într-o carte toate cele ce s-au săvârşit".
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ Θεῷ, διότι ἀναβαίνω πρὸς τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με, καὶ γράψατε πάντα τὰ συντελεσθέντα εἰς βιβλίον.

verses.geez: ወሶቤሃ፡ ተንሥአ፡ ወሖረ፡ ወኢርእይዎ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: And when they arose, they saw him no more.

translations.lxx: And when they arose, they saw him no more.
translations.ron: Şi sculându-se ei nu l-au mai văzut.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστησαν, καὶ οὐκ ἔτι εἶδον αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወአምኑ፡ በኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወግሩም፡ ወበእንተ፡ ዘአስተርአዮሙ፡ መልአከ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Then they confessed the great and wonderful works of God, and how the angel of the Lord had appeared unto them.

translations.lxx: Then they confessed the great and wonderful works of God, and how the angel of the Lord had appeared unto them.
translations.ron: Şi au început să istorisească lucrurile cele mari şi minunate ale lui Dumnezeu şi cum li s-a arătat îngerul Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξωμολογοῦντο τὰ ἔργα τὰ μεγάλα καὶ θαυμαστὰ αὐτοῦ, ὡς ὤφθη αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος Κυρίου.
